MEMS Product Engineer 
 Description - 
 
 Turn breakthrough MEMS technology into reliable products used by customers around the world. Join HP’s Print Microfluidics, Technology & Operations organization and help develop, qualify, and scale the fabrication processes behind HP’s industry-leading inkjet technology.

 The Opportunity
 HP is a global leader in inkjet technology, continually developing new capabilities and expanding its portfolio through advanced research, engineering, and product innovation.

 The AIM Lab in Corvallis, Oregon, is seeking an experienced MEMS Product Engineer to support the development and production of innovative inkjet components. In this role, you will work at the intersection of MEMS fabrication, circuit design, microfluidics, product development, and manufacturing .
 You will collaborate with program partners, Design Engineering, MEMS Integration and Quality, MEMS Process, Assembly, Planning, and Operations teams to develop, characterize, qualify, and stabilize MEMS fabrication processes. Your work will help ensure that new and released products meet demanding requirements for functionality, quality, reliability, manufacturability, cost, and production readiness.

 What You’ll Do

 Lead cross-functional groups of engineers with diverse technical backgrounds to develop robust product and process solutions.
 Partner with engineers and technicians to deliver reliable, cost-effective, and high-quality solutions in a fast-paced New Product Introduction environment.
 Support concept generation, process development, characterization, stabilization, optimization, quality improvement, and cost reduction.
 Develop new methods and capabilities within wafer and panel fabrication facilities.
 Oversee the Qualification of Change process for released products.
 Ensure product and technology development follows HP’s Product Development Program and Technology Development Program requirements.
 Establish and maintain product and engineering process flows across MEMS wafer and panel fabrication operations.
 Support part-number setup, S4 setup, and bill-of-material creation.
 Coordinate with Planning and Operations to establish manufacturable processes that support assurance of supply for customers worldwide.
 Collaborate with internal teams, management, and outsourced development partners to communicate progress and resolve technical issues.
 Document project methods, findings, decisions, and results.
 Present technical information and recommendations to engineering partners and business stakeholders.
 
 What You Bring

 Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in: Electrical Engineering Mechanical Engineering Chemical Engineering Industrial Engineering Microelectronics Microsystems Engineering Chemistry Physics Materials Science A related engineering or physical science discipline
 Research or academic experience related to silicon or MEMS processing.
 Five to seven years of experience in one or more of the following areas: MEMS fabrication Circuit design MEMS integration Fluidic architecture Microfluidics research and development
 Knowledge of or strong interest in silicon and MEMS processing.
 Experience troubleshooting complex technical or manufacturing issues.
 Demonstrated ability to generate ideas, solve problems, and work independently.
 Strong written, verbal, documentation, and presentation skills.
 Ability to organize and lead cross-functional engineering teams.
 
 Why Join HP?

 This is an opportunity to influence products from early development through manufacturing release. You will work alongside experienced engineers and technical partners to solve complex problems, improve fabrication capabilities, and help bring innovative MEMS and microfluidics technologies into production.
 If you enjoy translating advanced engineering concepts into dependable, manufacturable products, we encourage you to apply.

 
 The pay range for this role is $93,400 to $143,800 USD annually with additional opportunities for pay in the form of bonus and/or equity (applies to United States of America candidates only). Pay varies by work location, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience.

 Benefits: 

HP offers a comprehensive benefits package for this position, including:
 
 Health insurance 
 Dental insurance 
 Vision insurance 
 Long term/short term disability insurance 
 Employee assistance program 
 Flexible spending account 
 Life insurance 
 Generous time off policies, including; 
 4-12 weeks fully paid parental leave based on tenure 
 11 paid holidays 
 Additional flexible paid vacation and sick leave ( US benefits overview )
 
The compensation and benefits information is accurate as of the date of this posting. The Company reserves the right to modify this information at any time, with or without notice, subject to applicable law.
